findings.issue: Dependencies A14 and A03 still lack what A16 needs, and callers still disagree with A16's frozen interface. A14 line 40 still says A16's config keys feed the withdrawal rows. A14 has no deposit.manual_match, escrow.release, order.refund.batch, suspense.return, fee.sweep, rounding.sweep, shortfall.topup, ledger.adjustment or ledger.reversal rows. It stores no submit-time fact snapshot and has no replay resolver, yet A16 binding check 4(b) needs both. A03 has none of these action codes. A37 lines 103 and 270 post the refund batch's own approval_id (spelled orders.refund.batch on line 103) where A16 needs the offer.revert_and_refund approval. A17 lines 47, 99 and 122 use deposit.returned_unmatched (A16 has deposit.unmatched_returned), action code suspense.resolve (A16 has deposit.manual_match), 'A16 accepts it without an approval id' (A16 requires an AUTO approval id), and invented 'A16.x' failure rows (A16 has payout.failed and payout.returned). A20 line 55 calls snapshot({tenant_id, ...}) per tenant. The result: A16's catalogue registration test and its binding oracle cannot pass, and the node escalates at its own gate.
findings.fix: In the same fix pass, apply A16's 'Changes other nodes must make' list to A14 and A03, which are A16's ancestors: literal cent tiers, the missing action codes and policy rows with D07 roles, a stored submit-time fact snapshot plus policy_version, and a replay resolver exported from index.ts. Align A17 (deposit.unmatched_returned, deposit.manual_match, an AUTO approval id on every resolve, payout.failed and payout.returned by purpose), A37 (post the revert approval id and spell order.refund.batch) and A20 (platform-tenant snapshot signature). Add A20 and A42 to the change list.

findings.issue: The seed contract and the design-fidelity criterion cannot be met. A16 requires offer_escrow = 304888000 (A$3,048,880.00) holding the full order totals, and a client-money total of 1842031644. A06 locks the raise figures from the design (KST01 A$1,525,760.00, ANN01 A$1,019,200.00, UNL01 A$968,240.00). A06 records that the design's A$3,048,880.00 is superseded, and says the client-money total is derived, not locked. With fees included, those orders total about A$3,530,766, and no subset of the offerings sums to A$3,048,880.00. So A06 cannot satisfy both specs, and A16's gate could pass only on a faked escrow balance.
findings.fix: Make escrow and the client-money total derived from the seed: Fable computes the sum of the full totals of funded and allocated order lines of unreleased offerings from the order rows, and the total is wallets + that sum + distributions. Keep as locked figures only Alex's 342018 and 239592, the operating mirror, and the wallets and distributions mirrors if A06 agrees to lock them. Record A$3,048,880.00 and A$18,420,316.44 as superseded design figures, as A06 already does. Update A06 to full totals in escrow and fees in fee_payable_realx only for released offerings.

findings.issue: Agent provenance for withdrawal.pay relies on a payload 'originated_by' block that no node defines. A39 makes the maker of every withdrawal 'System threshold' (SVCA), and neither A14 nor A39 mentions originated_by. The origin rule therefore records SVCA, so the 'Agent provenance' challenge ('withdrawal.pay ... show the token prefix and the person') fails. An A39 worker that passes the investor's agent origin would be refused with LDG_ORIGIN_MISMATCH.
findings.fix: Define the originated_by schema in A16: { actor_kind, actor_id, token_id?, on_behalf_of_id? }, captured from the request ctx at submit and stored in payload_canonical. Add it to the change list for A14 (persist and expose it) and for A39 and A37 (populate it on every system-maker request).

findings.issue: distribution.pay_bank needs two approvals, the run's distribution.run.approve and the line's distribution.line.manual_payout, but ledger_journal has one approval_id column. The five binding checks, the partial UNIQUE(approval_id) and the audit event all assume one approval. A40 already sends a line_approval_id that A16 never defines, and A04 has no such column, so the builder must escalate.
findings.fix: Add ledger_journal.line_approval_id (nullable, mandatory only on distribution.pay_bank) to A16's column list and to A04. Run all five binding checks on each approval: the run approval as the file draw, and the line approval as single-object with a partial UNIQUE(line_approval_id). Write both ids to the audit event. Add oracle cases: line approval missing, line approval for another line, and line approval reused.

findings.issue: The same-day AUTO cap is defined differently in A16 and A14. A16 excludes the current request from same_day_sum_cents and applies AUTO only when sum + amount <= cap. A14's seeded AUTO row tests 'same-day sum lte 2500000'. Under A14's row, A16's challenges resolve the wrong way: A$20,000 then A$10,000 gives AUTO, not 4E, and a second A$24,999 gives AUTO. evaluateWithdrawalPolicy also re-implements the predicate in code instead of evaluating A14's applies_when data, so after a policy.change that restructures the rows the two resolvers can disagree. The wallet's auto_max_cents and second_approval_cents have no defined way to be read from predicate rows.
findings.fix: State the exact A14 predicate (same_day_sum_cents + amount_cents lte <cap>, with the provider excluding the current request) and add it to A14's change list. Have evaluateWithdrawalPolicy call A14's applies_when evaluator on policy_rows rather than hard-code it. Read the wallet thresholds from explicit numeric fields on A14's rows, such as threshold_cents, and never parse predicate strings.

findings.issue: A16's schema contract is out of step with A04. A04 line 174 has already folded the 'A04.1' columns into core, yet A16 still describes A04.1 as a pending loop that is an exception to the guarded-table rule. A16 uses columns in neither list: ledger_journal.posted_while_frozen, posted_after_cut, effective_date and memo, and line_approval_id (finding 4). A04's inventory (line 159) omits ledger_approved_file_line and ledger_payout. A16's escalation rule ('a column beyond the A04.1 list') would fire during Build.
findings.fix: Replace the A04.1 paragraph with 'A04 core carries these columns', and list every ledger_journal column A16 writes, including the flags, effective_date, memo and line_approval_id. Add ledger_approved_file_line and ledger_payout to A04's inventory with their read classes.

findings.issue: Some binding rules are incomplete. freezeAccount and unfreezeAccount name approval codes but not which approval states or clocks are accepted (SGL+R acts first, before ratification), or whether an approval id is single-use. The reversal floor ('4E, and 6E where the original was 6E') lets a 4E+Q revert refund be reversed at plain 4E. deposit.matched is refused 'on an inexact match', but the command carries no field the ledger can check.
findings.fix: Freeze: accept an SGL+R request once acted (any ratification state), check that object_ref is the account or investor, and make each id single-use per account. Lift: 4E+Q in an allowed state. Set the reversal floor to max(4E, the original's policy_code). Add a required match_kind ('exact' | 'inexact') on deposit.matched from A17, refuse anything but exact, and resolve the amount tier through A14's resolver.
